detail.longDescription: I installed a package and I can see it in node_modules with its type declarations file. But I’m still getting the “cannot find module or its corresponding type declarations” error when I attempt to start the dev server using ts-node. I’ve tried deleting and reinstalling node_modules and pnpm-lock.yaml , and restarting the VSCode TS server. A rough sketch of the project directory structure: MainProjectDir - package.json - tsconfig.base.json - tsconfig.json - vite.config.ts - server/ - tsconfig.json - ... - src/ - node_modules/ - ... When I attempt to start the dev server using npx ts-node --showConfig -P server/tsconfig.json server/server.ts , here are the ts compilerOptions that are displayed: "compilerOptions": { "target": "es2022", "noImplicitAny": true, "strictNullChecks": true, "esModuleInterop": true, "allowJs": true, "skipLibCheck": true, "types": [ "vite/client", "jest", "node" ], "module": "commonjs", "moduleResolution": "node10", "paths": { "@shared/*": [ "../src/shared/*" ], "@lib/*": [ "../src/lib/*" ] }, "sourceMap": true, "inlineSourceMap": false, "inlineSources": true, "declaration": false, "noEmit": false, "outDir": "./.ts-node", "allowSyntheticDefaultImports": true, "useDefineForClassFields": true } I’m confused about why typescript isn’t detecting the package’s type declarations file that is definitely present in node_modules. Would really appreciate any guidance.
